request: Build a small walking game in this empty project. A cube named `Player` starts at x = 0 and a goal pad named `Goal` sits at x = 3. Tapping an input action named `left` (the left arrow) or `right` (the right arrow) moves the player 1 m along x per tap, never past x = -3 or x = 3. When the player reaches x = 3, a counter named `won` becomes 1 and the screen says `You win!`; taps after that change nothing. `won` starts at 0.
